# LayerNLooms — Premium Custom Software & AI Development Agency

> Weaving Digital Experiences with Precision, Depth & AI. LayerNLooms is a full-stack custom software development agency specializing in scalable web applications, mobile apps (iOS & Android), AI & Machine Learning solutions, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise digital transformation.

## Core Services

- [Web Development](https://layernlooms.com/services/web-development): Modern, scalable web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Mobile App Development](https://layernlooms.com/services/mobile-app-development): High-performance native (Swift, Kotlin) and cross-platform (React Native, Flutter) mobile applications.
- [AI & ML Solutions](https://layernlooms.com/services/ai-ml-solutions): LLM integrations, custom machine learning models, NLP, computer vision, recommendation systems, and AI agent automation.
- [Cloud Infrastructure](https://layernlooms.com/services/cloud-infrastructure): Cloud-native architecture, AWS/GCP/Azure migration, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD, and DevOps automation.
- [UI/UX Design](https://layernlooms.com/services/ui-ux-design): User-centered interface design, design systems, interactive prototypes, and conversion optimization.
- [Digital Marketing](https://layernlooms.com/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven SEO, content marketing, PPC, and growth engineering.
- [SaaS Analytics](https://layernlooms.com/services/saas-analytics): Real-time analytics dashboards, telemetry, and revenue monitoring for SaaS platforms.

## Key Projects & Case Studies

- [ECOMM_STORE](https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/ecomm-store): Digital plant and botanical marketplace with multi-vendor support and seamless checkout.
- [Imgira Tools](https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/imgira-tools): 200+ free browser-based creator and developer utilities serving thousands of daily active users.
- [Temp Nova](https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/temp-nova): Stateless digital privacy suite offering disposable emails, temporary SMS, and self-destructing notes.
- [Explore with Unity](https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/explore-with-unity): Travel social platform enabling digital travel journaling and community trip planning.
- [Softivra](https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/softivra): Next-generation design system and interactive web agency platform.
- [Neritic Wellness](https://layernlooms.com/portfolio/neritic-wellness): Enterprise eCommerce admin dashboard with real-time sales telemetry and order management.

## Tech Stack & Expertise

- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, GSAP.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python, GraphQL, REST APIs, Microservices architecture.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Firestore.
- **AI / ML**: OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant).
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions.

- [Pricing Details](https://layernlooms.com/pricing): Flexible options including Fixed Scope Projects, Dedicated Development Teams, and Time & Materials (Hourly).
